oneLine: Transline Technologies gets SEBI nod for share offer IPO

sources.title: Transline Technologies IPO In Focus, AI Surveillance Firm Gets SEBI Nod For 1.62 Crore Share Offer

synopsis: Transline Technologies Limited, an AI surveillance and IT infrastructure firm, has received regulatory observations from SEBI for its initial public offering. The proposed public issue comprises an offer for sale of up to 1.62 crore equity shares by existing shareholders, with no fresh issue component. Consequently, the company will not receive any proceeds from the share sale. The equity shares are planned for listing on the BSE and National Stock Exchange. Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Limited is acting as the book-running lead manager for the offering, and Bigshare Services Private Limited is the registrar. The price band, subscription dates, and lot size for the IPO have not yet been announced.
